compiled_state.title: Implement --degradation/--degradation-type CLI flags in preconditions-record.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Add --degradation and --degradation-type CLI flags to plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-record.sh. These flags inject into the existing data JSON object — no schema version bump required. Fully backwards compatible: existing callers with no new flags see identical behavior.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-record.sh — add flag parsing for --degradation (bool presence flag, sets degradation:true in data) and --degradation-type (enum: inferred_decision | unresolved_question; validated at parse time, exits 1 on invalid value). Merge into existing data JSON when set.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Given existing callers (no new flags), When preconditions-record.sh runs, Then behavior is identical to pre-change (no data.degradation field injected)
- Given --degradation flag present, When script runs, Then resulting PRECONDITIONS event has data.degradation=true
- Given --degradation-type inferred_decision, When script runs, Then resulting event has data.degradation_type="inferred_decision"
- Given --degradation-type unresolved_question, When script runs, Then resulting event has data.degradation_type="unresolved_question"
- Given --degradation-type bad_value, When script runs, Then exit 1 with message listing valid enum values
- All T1 tests pass (GREEN)

## Done Definitions
- DD1: degradation_type enum validated at CLI boundary (bad value exits 1)
- DD2: backwards-compatible (existing callers unaffected)
- Ruff/ShellCheck clean
